nodes.label: Quarantine → inbox → resume loop
nodes.rationale: Full text that can't be obtained through the OA ladder is quarantined rather than the run stalling per-record; once every record has been attempted, missing.md halts the whole pipeline once with one consolidated table so the human can supply PDFs via inbox/ — this keeps synthesis honest (marked PROVISIONAL) instead of silently omitting studies.

nodes.label: Full-text acquisition ladder (rungs 0-8)
nodes.rationale: Nine ordered rungs (local library → PMC MCP → PMC PDF → Europe PMC → Unpaywall → OA fetch → preprint twin → browser handoff → quarantine) walked in order until real full text is obtained, because relying on any single source under-retrieves and abstract-only evidence must never be silently treated as full text.

nodes.label: Truncation detector (abstract-only downgrade)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately trigger-happy (body <1500 words or a paywall marker) because a false abstract_only costs only a label, while a false fulltext corrupts every downstream appraisal and GRADE judgement built on it — so the ladder keeps walking after a truncated hit rather than settling for it.
